card.text: The secondary star of an eclipsing pair in the Andromeda Galaxy, one orbit every 2.048644 days.

sources.label: Vilardell et al. 2009
sources.locator: Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 2: M, R, P and the distance

introduction.text: It has 15.4 solar masses and 5.6 solar radii; its partner has 21.7 and 9.2. The pair gave a direct distance to the galaxy: 724 kiloparsecs.
